one_line: Credit-Budgeted ICPC-Style Coding exposes ICPC-style coding with credit-budgeted evaluation as an auditable evaluation surface.
该工作把带额度预算的 ICPC 风格编程评测做成可审计的评测面，让智能体为每一次决策付出成本。

title: Problem
问题
html: Primary source: arXiv:2604.10182, submitted 2026-04-11, with arXiv comments marking ICLR 2026 acceptance; official companion repository is USACOArena. The paper asks how to evaluate autonomous coding agents when every generated token, local test, and elapsed second consumes a limited credit budget. The evaluation surface is an ICPC/USACO-style competition episode with problem statements, submissions, local tests, judge results, time, token/cost accounting, and final reports. It belongs in the atlas as a cost-aware executable coding benchmark, not as a static accuracy-only code dataset. Evidence is bounded by the Hydro-backed judging setup, released artifacts, public configs, and problem-content licensing.

一手来源是 arXiv:2604.10182，2026-04-11 提交，arXiv comment 标注 ICLR 2026 接收；官方配套仓库是 USACOArena。论文要问的是 autonomous coding agent 在每个生成 token、local test 和耗时秒数都消耗固定 credit budget 时如何评测。评测面是 ICPC/USACO 风格竞赛 episode，包含题面、提交、本地测试、judge 结果、时间、token/成本记账和最终报告。它应作为 cost-aware executable coding benchmark 收录，不是静态 accuracy-only 代码数据集。证据边界在 Hydro judging、发布 artifacts、公开 configs 和题目内容许可。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: USACOArena contributes an interactive ACM-ICPC-style arena with a strict credit economy. The core mechanism is unified accounting: generation, testing, and wall-clock time all deplete budget, so agents must trade off exploration, debugging, and final submission. The official README reports a Hydro-based judging and problem-management workflow, public paper configs, competitor configs, problem lists, benchmark CLI, and reproduction scripts. The feedback contract is programmatic: Hydro/problem tests and USACOArena API reports determine judged outcomes, while credit accounting shapes the score context. Closest comparisons are competitive-programming benchmarks that measure pass rate without charging each decision.

USACOArena 的贡献是一个带严格 credit economy 的 ACM-ICPC 风格交互 arena。核心机制是统一记账：生成、测试和 wall-clock time 都消耗预算，agent 必须在探索、调试和最终提交之间权衡。官方 README 说明使用 Hydro-based judging 与 problem-management workflow，并公开 paper configs、competitor configs、problem lists、benchmark CLI 和 reproduction scripts。反馈契约是程序式的：Hydro/题目测试和 USACOArena API 报告决定 judged outcomes，credit accounting 给出分数上下文。最近对比对象是不对每个决策收费的竞赛编程 benchmark。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: contest problem list, agent/model config, competition-rule config, Hydro problemset, optional local resource dataset, and provider API settings.
  2. Pipeline: deploy Hydro with the USACOArena addon, start the arena API and UI, run scripts/run_competition.py, let agents generate code and invoke local tests under credit accounting, then export reports and metric timelines.
  3. Outputs: competition id, logs, submissions, judge outcomes, final intelligence report, metric timeline, and budget/cost traces.
  4. Feedback: Hydro tests and arena APIs provide pass/fail or score; elapsed time, token generation, and local tests deplete credit.
  5. Reproducibility: pin Hydro version/addon, problemset zip, local resource dataset, config files, API model versions, budget rules, hardware/runtime, and release date.

1. 输入：竞赛题目列表、agent/model config、competition-rule config、Hydro problemset、可选本地资源数据集和 provider API 设置。
  2. 流程：部署 Hydro 与 USACOArena addon，启动 arena API 和 UI，运行 scripts/run_competition.py，让 agent 在 credit accounting 下生成代码并调用本地测试，再导出报告和 metric timeline。
  3. 输出：competition id、日志、提交、judge outcomes、final intelligence report、metric timeline 和 budget/cost traces。
  4. 反馈：Hydro tests 和 arena API 给 pass/fail 或分数；耗时、token 生成和本地测试都会扣 credit。
  5. 复现需固定 Hydro 版本/addon、problemset zip、本地资源数据、config 文件、API 模型版本、预算规则、硬件/runtime 和发布日期。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The arXiv abstract reports the central finding that frontier single agents and swarms fail to optimally balance accuracy against budget constraints, producing divergent path-dependent behavior. The repository supports this claim operationally by exposing paper-aligned competition configs, competitor configs, problem lists, benchmark scripts, report export, and metric timeline export. Instance-level evidence is a judged submission trace plus credit ledger, not final solved/unsolved status alone. Evidence is bounded by Hydro setup, public problemset release, USACO/third-party content availability, exact budget rules, API model versions, and scaffold decisions.

arXiv 摘要的核心证据是：frontier single agents 和 swarms 仍不能在准确率与预算约束之间达到最优平衡，并出现路径依赖的分化行为。官方仓库通过 paper-aligned competition configs、competitor configs、problem lists、benchmark scripts、report export 和 metric timeline export 支撑可复查运行。单条样本证据是 judged submission trace 加 credit ledger，而不是最终 solved/unsolved 状态本身。证据受 Hydro 设置、公开 problemset release、USACO/第三方内容可得性、预算规则、API 模型版本和脚手架决策约束。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The prior baseline is executable coding evaluation that rewards final accepted solutions while treating tokens, testing, retries, and elapsed time as external bookkeeping. USACOArena moves those decisions inside the benchmark via a unified credit budget. The direction signal is resource-aware coding-agent evaluation for large agent swarms and deployment cost. The quality signal is an open Hydro integration, public configs, problem lists, logs/report tooling, and reproduction documentation. ICPC-style judging and token accounting are not new separately. Reuse requires checking problem-content rights, dataset/corpus rights, MIT code scope, Hydro version, hidden/public tests, budget parameters, and whether local tests leak solution strategy.

已有基线通常奖励最终 accepted solution，而把 tokens、测试、重试和耗时当作外部统计。USACOArena 把这些决策通过统一 credit budget 放进 benchmark 内部。方向信号是面向大规模 agent swarm 和部署成本的 resource-aware coding-agent evaluation。质量信号是开放 Hydro 集成、公开 configs、problem lists、日志/报告工具和复现文档。ICPC-style judging 和 token accounting 单独看并不新。复用前要查题目内容权利、dataset/corpus 权利、MIT 代码范围、Hydro 版本、hidden/public tests、预算参数，以及本地测试是否泄漏解题策略。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is only relative to the imported problemset and judge tests. A lower credit cost can reflect under-exploration as well as efficiency, so cost and correctness must be read together. The README says the released Hydro problemset includes public USACO 2025-2026 season contests but excludes the newest March open contest until official data is published; this is a version boundary. Code is MIT licensed, but USACO materials and third-party corpora retain their own terms. API latency, local hardware, and provider pricing can change budget interpretation.

正确性只相对于导入的 problemset 和 judge tests 成立。更低 credit cost 可能代表效率，也可能代表探索不足，所以成本和正确性必须一起读。README 说明发布的 Hydro problemset 已包含公开 USACO 2025-2026 season contests，但最新 March open contest 因官方数据未发布而缺失，这是版本边界。代码是 MIT，但 USACO 材料和第三方语料保留各自条款。API latency、本地硬件和 provider 价格都会改变预算解释。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use USACOArena as a schema for cost-aware executable coding episodes. Preserve problem id, public/hidden test policy, judge result, local-test calls, generated token count, elapsed time, credit ledger, model/provider, scaffold, config files, Hydro/problemset version, and final report. It is useful for comparing agent strategies that have similar pass rates but different exploration and spending profiles. For atlas work, keep evaluation reward, training reward, and budget audit as separate fields.

可把 USACOArena 作为 cost-aware executable coding episode 的 schema。需要保留 problem id、public/hidden test policy、judge result、本地测试调用、生成 token 数、耗时、credit ledger、模型/provider、脚手架、config 文件、Hydro/problemset 版本和最终报告。它适合比较 pass rate 接近但探索和花费模式不同的 agent 策略。做 atlas 时要把 evaluation reward、training reward 和 budget audit 分成不同字段。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Do not reduce USACOArena to another coding leaderboard. The key variable is the credit ledger: tokens, local tests, retries, and time are part of the task outcome. Read problemset version and budget rules before comparing models. A swarm can solve more tasks while exhausting budget faster; that is a different claim from being more deployable.
不要把 USACOArena 简化成另一个 coding leaderboard。关键变量是 credit ledger：tokens、本地测试、重试和时间都是任务结果的一部分。比较模型前先读 problemset 版本和预算规则。swarm 可能解出更多题但更快耗尽预算；这不同于更适合部署。
